dataSetInformation.common:name: ILCD2011; Resource depletion - water; midpoint; freshwater scarcity; Swiss Ecoscarcity2006
dataSetInformation.impactIndicator: Freshwater scarcity: Scarcity-adjusted amount of water used.

referenceQuantity.common:shortDescription: Scarcity adjusted mass of water used

geography.geographicalRepresentativenessDescriptio: Applicable to specified regions (i.e. countries). Ratio between critical and actual flow is provided for many countries.

impactModel.modelDescription: The model relates water use to local scarcity of water.
impactModel.consideredMechanisms: Ratio between actual and critical flow is considered to be representative of the water scarcity and thus the seriousness of water consumption.

modellingAndValidation.useAdviceForDataSet: Data per country may not represent water scarcity in all regions of large countries, more detailed regional data is available from http://www.esu-services.ch/projects/ubp06/google-layer/. Applicable on total water use or consumptive water use. Factors are available in EcoSpold format too.

review.common:reviewDetails: Model documentation and results available. Most appropriate among existing methods, though including a rudimentary model. Suggested in SETAC-UNEP results. Seen as promising concept to assess water use and differentiate situations where water extraction causes different levels of damages.

common:referenceToCompleteReviewReport.common:shortDescription: Review report on recommended LCIA methods

common:commissionerAndGoal.common:project: LCIA method original development within the Ecological Scarcity Method 2006 . Documentation as ILCD formatted data set, mapping to the ILCD elementary flows, and additional quality checks by the EC’s JRC-IES and with contractual support projects, partly financed under several Administrative Arrangements on the European Platform on LCA - EPLCA' between JRC and DG ENV, (070402/2006/443456/G4, 070307/2007/474521/G4, 070307/2008/513489/G4).
common:commissionerAndGoal.common:intendedApplications: Swiss product policy and international use in LCA.

common:referenceToPersonOrEntityGenerati.common:shortDescription: European Platform on Life Cycle Assessment (EPLCA) project team at: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (DG JRC), Institute for Environment and Sustainability (IES)

recommendationBy.meaning: Recommended, but to be applied with caution.For more information see: ILCD Handbook on recommended LCIA methods for Europe.

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: The data set can be used free of charge by anybody to perform LCA studies, to distribute it to third parties, to convert it to other formats, to develop own data sets etc. as long as the copyright and license conditions for the ELCD data sets and the ILCD format are met that can be accessed via http://lca.jrc.ec.europa.eu and are part of the ELCD database distribution package. Please note e.g. that reference must be given to the 'Owner of data set' (who may have additional copyright and license requirements on the particular data set that are to be met) and to the 'ELCD database' plus version number, when using the data set or parts thereof. Please note also that any modifications/omissions of the data set results in invalidity of any existing 'Official recommendation of data set by governmental body', that the impression must be avoided that this would still be an original ELCD data set, and that the content of further fields may have to be adjusted. For details see the aforementioned copyright and license conditions as well as those the "Owner of data set" may have put into force.
